src.title: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice // Arroz Crujiente con Atún Picante

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice

items.i: avocado, mashed with lime and salt

steps: Press chilled cooked rice into a flat, even slab and pan-fry it in a little oil until golden and crunchy on both sides.
Stir the tuna with the mayo, sriracha, sesame oil, lime juice, soy sauce and green onion.
Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado over the crispy rice, then top with the spicy tuna, more green onion and sesame seeds.
Cut into squares and serve right away while the rice is crunchy.
recipes.notes: The video is a 17-second clip in Spanish that names the ingredients but no amounts, so quantities, servings and nutrition are estimates.
